authorization: User requested book audit, human-centred narrative and a verified well-known saying or song excerpt.
scope: Local book manuscript and PDF revision; published website unchanged.

assignments.Samanta: output/dongria-book-design/build_book.py, manuscript/, narrative changes record; sequential chapter edits; build after coordinator marker
assignments.Drishti: Read-only independent AI editorial and image audit

limits: No invented interviews, dialogue, sensory scenes or emotions
No claim of community or human specialist review
All source notes and factual qualifications preserved
additional_user_direction: Insert line art based on elements from Dongria Kondh life.

audit_findings.overall: All twelve chapters already contain credible named human agency. Targeted revision is preferable to wholesale rewriting. Repeated evidence-limit paragraphs and catalogue chronology sometimes displace people.
audit_findings.dongariya-life: Bring differing household crop priorities forward.
audit_findings.kapadaganda: Foreground learning, work, payment and makers choices.
audit_findings.ornaments-in-use: Preserve practical use and wearer interpretation.
audit_findings.niyamgiri: Connect cultivation knowledge and villagers defining claims; retain dates and legal limits.
audit_findings.seed-keeping: Keep named growers, priestesses and messengers active; avoid timeless harmony.
audit_findings.forest-foods: Preserve regional multi-community scope and women choosing what to gather, grow and buy.
audit_findings.harvest-to-market: Preserve selling time, costs and growers requests.
audit_findings.homes-and-repair: Keep Mana preference for secure shelter; avoid romanticising thatch.
audit_findings.learning-and-belonging: Foreground students and peer teaching; reduce duplicated inventory framing.
audit_findings.kuvi-and-jatapu-script: Avoid repeating classroom opening; distinguish all three writing systems.
audit_findings.songs-and-singers: Centre Dambu and remembrance before distribution and album records.
audit_findings.kotpad-and-kapadaganda: Begin with named makers and different work, preserving unproven supply connection.

literary_sources.author: Rabindranath Tagore

resolved_editorial_findings: Household crop priorities precede administrative profile
Learning, work and payment precede colour glossary

Language chapter bridges from prior classroom account instead of repeating opening
Kotpad comparison begins with named makers
Further reading consolidated to avoid web-style closing fragments
Verified external epigraph and bounded attributed song excerpt added
remaining_limits: Research and programme chronology remains where needed for factual distinctions
No community or human specialist review conducted
Original song audio and unnamed translator remain unverified
Tagged-PDF accessibility and physical printer proof not established

validation.narrative: All12chapters and revision diff reviewed by separate AI reviewer Drishti and root; excerpt wording verified against published sources.
validation.visual: Root inspected fullbook contact sheets and reading-size preface/song/line-art/changed closing pages; final compact navigation and final forest section checked after revision.

technical.comparison_basis: book manuscript overrides; all source note IDs retained, note 4 in songs amended

validation.scope_limit: Not a fresh re-verification of every factual source, community review, or printer certification.

publication: Not required for local book delivery; no website changes or deployment.
